claims.claim: 99 Nights in the Forest brings back the Thanksgiving Challenge, launching the day before Thanksgiving on November 25, 2026 and running to December 5: players cook dishes in a crock pot and serve forest guests.
claims.notes: Official Roblox event description (via AbuseTime, Roblox Events API): 'The thanksgiving challenge is back, with a few changes from last year. We are launching this the day before Thanksgiving, so mid week!'; starts Nov 25, 2026, 6:30 PM, ends Dec 5, 2026, 9:25 AM. Note: several guides still list last year's Nov 29, 2025 schedule — the 2026 start is Nov 25.
